educationalGoal: Considerable progress has been made in computer networks and ever-increasing amounts of information are now being exchanged. In this course, we learn the information theory and coding theory. First, we learn how to quantify information and related knowledge based on the probability theory. Next, we study the information source and its coding method. Finally, we learn how channel coding can be used to correct errors that have occurred in the channel.
advice:

              Considerable progress has been made in computer networks and ever-increasing amounts of information are now being exchanged. In this course, we learn the information theory and coding theory. First, we learn how to quantify information and related knowledge based on the probability theory. Next, we study the information source and its coding method. Finally, we learn how channel coding can be used to correct errors that have occurred in the channel.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Information theory can be used to quantify and encode information output by an information source. It can also be used to correct errors that have occurred in the channel. The topics of this course are as follows:

1. Set and probability
2. Conditional probability and Bayes' theorem
3. Definition of information content and entropy
4. Information source
5. Entropy of information source
6. Source coding
7. Channel coding and error-correcting code

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Students are expected to review the following: (1) calculation of probability taken up in "Probability and Statistics(E537-01)", (2) logarithm calculations. If there is anything they cannot understand, they will need to resolve those issues by utilizing office hours. Students are expected to make good use of the exercises at the back of the textbook.
